job.job_description:
R1 RCM India is proud to be recognized amongst India''s Top 50 Best Companies to Work For 2023 by Great Place To Work Institute. We are committed to transform the healthcare industry with our innovative revenue cycle management services. Our goal is to make healthcare simpler and enable efficiency for healthcare systems, hospitals, and physician practices. With over 30,000 employees globally, we are about 14,000 strong in India with offices in Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai. Our inclusive culture ensures that every employee feels valued, respected, and appreciated with a robust set of employee benefits and engagement activities.
Full Stack Developer
Location: Noida / Hybrid
Experience: 02 Years
Employment Type: Full-time
Role Overview
We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Developerwith strong fundamentals in .NET Core and React.js, exposure to Gen AI and modern coding practices (Vibe coding), and experience or interest in Azure / Google Cloud platforms.
You will work across the entire development lifecyclebuilding scalable backend services, intuitive frontends, and integrating AI capabilities into enterprise systems.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain full-stack web applicationsusing .NET Core (Backend)and React.js (Frontend)
Build and consume REST APIsand integrate frontend with backend services
Design scalable and responsive UI components using modern React practices
Work with databases (SQL/NoSQL)and ensure efficient data management
Deploy and monitor applications on Azure or Google Cloud
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA teams in an Agile setup
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code (with unit testing)
Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization
Explore and integrate Generative AI capabilities (LLMs, APIs, prompt-based features)into applications
Use Gitfor version control and CI/CD workflows
Required Skills
Core Technical Skills
Backend: C#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
Frontend: React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
API: RESTful services design integration
Database: SQL Server / PostgreSQL / MongoDB
Cloud DevOps
Exposure to Azure / Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployments
AI / Modern Development
Basic understanding of Generative AI / LLM concepts (OpenAI, Azure AI, etc.)
Ability to work with APIs and external integrations
Awareness of modern development practices and tools
Tools
Git (GitHub / Azure DevOps)
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum
Good to Have
Internship or project experience in full-stack development
Exposure to microservices architecture
Basic knowledge of Docker / containers
Experience with AI-based features or chatbots
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science / IT or related field
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good communication and teamwork abilities
What We Offer
Opportunity to work on AI-driven enterprise products
Exposure to cloud-native and scalable architectures
Fast learning environment with hands-on ownership
Career growth into full-stack + AI engineer role
Ideal Candidate Profile
Strong coding fundamentals
Curious about AI + Cloud + Modern Web Development
Ability to quickly learn and adapt
Self-driven and outcome-oriented
Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests.
Our associates are given valuable opportunities to contribute, to innovate and create meaningful work that makes an impact in the communities we serve around the world. We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package.
